name: Addronix Addons for Elementor
author: jasminghadiya

sections.description:
Addronix Addons for Elementor is a lightweight, high-performance addon designed to extend the capabilities of the Elementor Page Builder without slowing down your website. It provides 51 unique animated & essential widgets and 10 advanced extensions including Motion Effects and a Display Conditions engine.

🔥 10 Powerful Extensions

  • Advanced Display Conditions: Easily control the visibility of ANY Elementor widget, column, or section. Create complex AND/OR logic rules based on:
    • Login Status: Show or hide elements for logged-in or logged-out users.
    • User Roles: Target specific roles (e.g., Administrator, Subscriber).
    • Browser & OS: Show different content to Chrome users, Windows users, mobile devices, etc.
    • Date & Time: Schedule content visibility based on specific dates and times.
    • URL Parameters: Dynamically show elements if a specific URL parameter (e.g., ?promo=true) is present. Perfect for marketing campaigns!
  • Header & Footer Builder: Create custom headers and footers using Elementor templates with full display condition support.
  • Mega Menu Builder: Build beautiful mega menus directly from the WordPress navigation menus screen.
  • Advanced Backgrounds: Apply advanced background effects (particles, animated gradients, SVG waves, noise) to any Elementor section or container, plus Floating Effects for any element.
  • Loop Builder: Display any post type in custom Elementor loop templates with full query control.
  • Sticky Elements: Make any section, container, or widget sticky on scroll with customizable offset and effects.
  • Menu Badges: Add custom badges (HOT, NEW, SALE) to WordPress navigation menus with custom colors.
  • Motion Effects: For any widget, container, section or column — entrance animations Elementor does not include (blur in, wipe reveal, circle reveal, 3D flip, skew, scale down), stagger (animate the children one after another), scroll effects (parallax move, rotate, scale, fade, blur) and mouse effects (3D tilt, magnetic pull, cursor spotlight and glow border). Pure CSS + a small vanilla script that loads only where it is used.
  • Horizontal Scroll: Pin any container and slide its items sideways while visitors scroll down, with item width, gap, top offset, scroll length, progress bar and per-device control.
  • Site Effects: Custom cursor (with “cursor text” on hover), smooth wheel scrolling, preloader, page transitions using the browser’s native View Transitions, scroll progress bar and back-to-top button. Each loads only when switched on and never inside the Elementor editor.

⚡ Performance First

Zero bloat. Enable or disable individual widgets from the backend dashboard to keep your editor fast and clean. Assets are loaded only on pages that actually use AAFE widgets.

✨ 51 Widgets Included

Animated Buttons

  1. Bubble Button — Button with bubble animation effect.
  2. Circle Button — Circular animated button.
  3. Kinetic Stagger Button — Button with kinetic staggered character animation.
  4. Marquee Button — Scrolling marquee-style animated button.
  5. Origin Button — Button with origin-based hover effects.
  6. Slide Icon Button — Button with sliding icon reveal effect.

Hero & Banner Sections

  1. Dual Heading — Dual-color, gradient & marker highlighted heading with eyebrow badge.
  2. Dual Marquee Hero — Hero with dual scrolling marquee image columns and central content.
  3. Shuffle Hero — Hero section with shuffling animated text.
  4. Spaced Text Banner — Full-width text banner with letter spacing animation.

Cards & Content

  1. Animated Hike Card — 3D stacked image card with hover spread effect.
  2. Animated Profile Card — Interactive profile card with clip-path reveal animation on hover.
  3. Bounce Image Content — Content section with bouncing image.
  4. Content Showcase — Hover-activated full-screen content reveal.
  5. Glass Showcase — Glassmorphism content showcase card.
  6. Hover Reveal Card — Card with sliding image reveal on hover.
  7. Icon Cards — Icon + text feature cards with animations.
  8. Linear Card — Clean linear-style content card.
  9. Scroll Stack Cards — Cards that stack on top of each other while scrolling.

Galleries & Carousels

  1. Before After Slider — Interactive before/after image comparison slider with touch drag and hover modes.
  2. FX Slider — Full-screen image slider with WebGL-like effects.
  3. Headline Gallery — Gallery with large headline overlay on hover.
  4. Image 3D Carousel — 3D rotating image carousel.
  5. Image Sphere — Images arranged in a rotating 3D sphere.
  6. Kinetic Cylinder Gallery — 3D rotating kinetic cylinder image gallery.
  7. Orbit Image Showcase — Images in an orbital animation layout.
  8. Transaction Carousel — Smooth credit-card-style swipeable transaction carousel.

Lists & Interactive

  1. Accordion Feature Section — Accordion with feature highlights.
  2. Expanding Cards — Interactive expanding content cards.
  3. FAQ Accordion — Schema-ready SEO FAQ accordion with Google rich snippets.
  4. Feature Tabs — Tabbed feature showcase with media panel and Lottie support.
  5. Hover Image List — List items with large hover image reveal.
  6. Marquee Gallery CTA — Full-width marquee image gallery with call-to-action overlay.
  7. Marquee Radio Select — Horizontal scrolling radio button selector.
  8. Morphing Feature Pills — Pill-shaped feature cards that morph into full detail cards on click.
  9. Scroll Cards — Interactive stacked cards with smooth layered scroll reveals.
  10. Services Showcase — Services grid with animated reveal on hover.

Popups & Drawers

  1. Modal Popup — Nested popup built with containers and any widget, with exit-intent, scroll-depth, click and URL-hash triggers and 10 animations.
  2. Off-Canvas Drawer — Nested side drawer for menus or any content, with push / fade / scale effects and swipe to close.

Data & Forms

  1. Data Table — Sortable, searchable table with pagination, CSV / Google Sheets / JSON sources and CSV export.
  2. Form Styler — Style Contact Form 7, WPForms, Fluent Forms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Forminator or any HTML form.

Navigation

  1. Nav Menu — Custom styled navigation menu widget with mega menu support.

Posts & Loops

  1. Loop Grid — Custom post loop grid or carousel powered by the Loop Builder extension.

Pricing & Products

  1. Countdown Timer — High-converting sales timer with Due Date & Evergreen urgency modes and custom expiry actions.
  2. Product Features — Product feature highlight section.

WooCommerce

  1. Woo Product Grid — Product grid with AJAX add to cart and quick view.
  2. Woo Categories — Product categories as a grid or carousel.
  3. Woo Mini Cart — Cart icon with drawer, dropdown or popup cart, coupons and a free-shipping bar.

Teams & Testimonials

  1. Stagger Testimonials — Animated staggered testimonials layout.
  2. Team Showcase — Team member cards with social links.
  3. Testimonials Columns — Multi-column testimonial grid.

Why Choose Addronix Addons for Elementor?
Our goal is to provide premium-quality widgets and features absolutely free. The codebase is optimized, follows WordPress security standards, and integrates seamlessly into the native Elementor UI.

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin uses the following third-party libraries, all of which are GPL-compatible:

  • Lottie Player (MIT License) — Bundled with the plugin. Used for Lottie animation support in Feature Tabs. https://lottiefiles.com/
  • Swiper (MIT License) — Not bundled; the copy that ships with Elementor is used for carousel widgets. https://swiperjs.com/

All JavaScript animations use native browser APIs (CSS transitions, Intersection Observer, requestAnimationFrame) — no proprietary animation libraries.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the addronix-addons-for-elementor directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor (free) is installed and active.
  4. Go to Addronix Addons in your WordPress dashboard to configure settings and disable unused widgets.
  5. Open any page with Elementor to start using the new widgets and the Display Conditions tab (under the ‘Advanced’ tab of any element).
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor Pro?

No! Addronix Addons for Elementor works perfectly with the free version of Elementor. In fact, it adds features (like Display Conditions and Header/Footer Builder) that are normally only found in Elementor Pro.

Will this slow down my website?

Not at all. The plugin is built with performance in mind. You can disable any widget you are not using from the backend dashboard, ensuring zero unnecessary scripts or styles are loaded on the frontend.

How do I use the Display Conditions?

In the Elementor Editor, click on any Widget, Column, or Section. Go to the Advanced tab, and scroll down to Addronix Display Conditions. From there, you can add multiple condition groups using AND/OR logic.

How many widgets does this plugin include?

Addronix Addons for Elementor includes 51 widgets and 10 extensions — all completely free with no upsells.

Are any external services used?

The plugin does not track visitors and sends no data to the plugin author. All JavaScript and CSS files are loaded locally from within the plugin (or from Elementor). Only the two cases below load files from another server. Front-end widgets such as Loop Grid, Woo Product Grid and Woo Mini Cart only talk to your own site’s admin-ajax.php / wc-ajax endpoints.

Google Fonts: many widget designs use the Inter Tight, Inter and Sora fonts. On pages that show one of those widgets the plugin loads them from Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com) in a single request; pages without those widgets load nothing. You can switch this off in Addronix Addons → Settings → Performance → Load widget fonts from Google Fonts, and the widgets then use your theme fonts. See Google’s Privacy Policy.

The other exception is the Data Table widget: if you choose the “CSV File / URL” or “Google Sheets” data source and enter an external URL, your server downloads that file (for example from docs.google.com) to build the table. Nothing is sent from your site except a standard HTTP request for that file. If you use a Google Sheets URL, Google’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy apply. No external request is made for the “Manual” or “Paste CSV / JSON” sources, or for CSV files in your own Media Library.

2.2.10

  • New extension — Motion Effects: blur / wipe / circle / 3D flip / skew / scale-down entrance animations, stagger children, scroll-linked effects (move, rotate, scale, fade, blur) and hover effects (3D tilt, magnetic, spotlight, glow border) for any element. Respects “reduce motion”.
  • New extension — Horizontal Scroll for containers.
  • New extension — Site Effects: custom cursor, smooth scroll, preloader, native page transitions, scroll progress bar and back-to-top button (Settings → Site Effects).
  • Performance: every new effect loads its files only on pages (or sites) that use it; animations use transform / opacity only and update once per frame for on-screen elements.
  • Performance: Google Fonts are no longer loaded on every page. Inter Tight / Inter / Sora load in one request only on pages with widgets that use them (the 18 render-blocking @import rules in widget CSS were removed). New setting: Performance → Load widget fonts from Google Fonts.
  • Readme: corrected widget and extension counts (51 widgets), listed every widget (Scroll Stack Cards, Modal Popup, Off-Canvas Drawer, Data Table, Form Styler and the WooCommerce widgets were missing), fixed the Stable tag and clarified the external-request and third-party library notes.

2.2.0

  • Modal Popup: rebuilt as a nested widget — design the popup with containers & any widget. New triggers (exit intent, scroll depth, CSS selector, URL hash, JS API), display frequency, 10 smooth animations, full layout / close-button / backdrop styling, focus trap and jump-free scroll lock.
  • Off-Canvas Drawer: rebuilt as a nested widget (containers, grids, any widget). Push / fade / scale effects, accordion menus, logo header, swipe to close, full styling.
  • Data Table: rebuilt.     • Responsive Vertical Timeline: Seamlessly transforms into an interactive vertical glowing timeline on tablet and mobile devices with animated progress fill and illuminated milestone dots.
    • Dynamic Milestone Balancing: Smooth cubic bezier spline algorithm dynamically balances curve coordinates for any number of milestones.

  • Admin: dashboard widget filters / counters stay in sync after toggling; failed toggles are reverted; settings form no longer triggers a JavaScript error in Elementor’s admin script.
  • Code quality: fixed PHP 8.2+ dynamic property deprecation, removed debug logging and HTML debug comments, repaired garbled (double-encoded) characters in source files, uninstall now also removes badge meta and cached data.

Why Choose Addronix Addons for Elementor?
Our goal is to provide premium-quality widgets and features absolutely free. The codebase is optimized, follows WordPress security standards, and integrates seamlessly into the native Elementor UI.

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin uses the following third-party libraries, all of which are GPL-compatible:

  • Lottie Player (MIT License) — Bundled with the plugin. Used for Lottie animation support in Feature Tabs. https://lottiefiles.com/
  • Swiper (MIT License) — Not bundled; the copy that ships with Elementor is used for carousel widgets. https://swiperjs.com/

All JavaScript animations use native browser APIs (CSS transitions, Intersection Observer, requestAnimationFrame) — no proprietary animation libraries.
